terminal_name: BESTC Bataan FSRU LNG Terminal (new; discovery)
issue: The PNOC-BESTC 10 Feb 2026 MOU bundles an FSRU (staged here as a new GGIT LNG import terminal) WITH an ~1,800 MW (3x600 MW) gas-fired combined-cycle power plant. The power plant is out of scope for the LNG Terminals tracker and belongs in the Global Oil & Gas Plant Tracker (GOGPT). This is a captive-power colocation case (LNG feedstock -> colocated gas power).
suggested_action: Hand the ~1,800 MW Bataan gas CCPP to the GOGPT team / run the LNG<->GOGPT captive-power colocation matcher so the power component is tracked there, linked to this FSRU terminal. GGIT edit lane covers only the FSRU/LNG-import side.
